heading: Under Secretary of Agriculture for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: There is established in the Department the position of Under Secretary of Agriculture for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs.

tree.heading: Appointment
tree.text: The Under Secretary of Agriculture for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs shall be appointed by the President, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate.

children.heading: Principal functions
children.text: The Secretary shall delegate to the Under Secretary of Agriculture for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs those functions and duties under the jurisdiction of the Department that are related to trade and foreign agricultural affairs.
